symbols.name: deletion_initiated
symbols.description: A Property Owner has initiated the property deletion process

symbols.name: confirmation_prompted
symbols.description: The Platform displays a prompt requesting confirmation for the deletion

symbols.name: deletion_confirmed
symbols.description: The Property Owner has confirmed the deletion

symbols.name: property_marked_deleted
symbols.description: The Property status is marked as deleted in the system

symbols.name: property_visible_in_ui
symbols.description: The Property is visible in the user interface

symbols.name: property_deleted
symbols.description: The Property has been successfully deleted

symbols.name: confirmation_message_displayed
symbols.description: The Platform displays a confirmation message indicating successful deletion

symbols.name: redirected_to_properties_list
symbols.description: The Platform redirects the user to the properties list page

symbols.name: property_data_retained
symbols.description: The Property data is retained in the system for audit purposes

symbols.name: deletion_attempted
symbols.description: A Property Owner has attempted to delete a Property

symbols.name: property_belongs_to_owner
symbols.description: The Property belongs to the User Account of the Property Owner attempting the deletion

symbols.name: deletion_denied
symbols.description: The Platform denies the deletion request

symbols.name: authorization_error_displayed
symbols.description: The Platform displays an authorization error message

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner initiates property deletion, THE Platform SHALL prompt for confirmation before proceeding
rules.reading: When a Property Owner initiates the deletion of a property, the Platform must display a confirmation prompt.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner confirms deletion, THE Platform SHALL mark the Property as deleted so that it is no longer visible in the user interface
rules.reading: If a Property Owner confirms the deletion, the system must mark the property as deleted and ensure it is no longer visible in the user interface.

rules.text: WHEN a Property is deleted, THE Platform SHALL display a confirmation message and redirect to the properties list
rules.reading: When a Property is successfully deleted, the Platform must display a confirmation message indicating the success and redirect the user to the properties list page.

rules.text: WHEN a Property is deleted, THE Platform SHALL ensure the Property data is retained for audit purposes and is not visible in the user interface
rules.reading: Whenever a property is successfully deleted, the system must retain its data for auditing while ensuring it is no longer visible in the user interface.

rules.text: WHEN a Property Owner attempts to delete a Property that does not belong to their User Account, THE Platform SHALL deny the deletion and display an authorization error message
rules.reading: If a property owner attempts to delete a property that does not belong to their account, the platform must deny the deletion request and display an authorization error message.
